The reference book also lists his species.</ref> they took him back to their village to put him on display.<ref name="gone" /> Later, when the [[Snow King]] froze<ref name="scepter" /> the [[Moon/Legends|moon]],<ref name="endor-db">{{DB|location|endor|Endor}}</ref> the mimphs used shovels to rid their village of snow.<ref name="scepter" />
